title: The Bangkok map: the look
kaylee: Bangkok looks like Bangkok now: a wide teal river full of longtail boats, a candy skyline, palms on the banks, a pink taxi, a fruit boat and kites to poke.
questions: Does the board remind you of Bangkok now?
